mapper.select: select voucher_id, merchant_id, voucher_name, discount_cost, start_time, end_time, create_time from merchant_voucher where merchant_id=#{merchantId} order by voucher_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select voucher_id, merchant_id, voucher_name, discount_cost, start_time, end_time, create_time from merchant_voucher where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() order by voucher_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
select voucher_id, merchant_id, voucher_name, voucher_description, discount_cost, min_cost, start_time, end_time, create_time from merchant_voucher where voucher_id=#{voucherId}
select count(*) from merchant_voucher where voucher_id=#{voucherId} and merchant_id=#{merchantId}
